description.en: Self-hosted plugin index for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Add it once in Discover to browse, install and track updates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）自建插件索引。在「发现」里添加一次，即可浏览、安装并跟踪更新。

description.en: Chime + system/browser notification when a task finishes, plus a Tasks sidebar panel filtering unread / running / completed sessions; unread state persists locally.
description.zh: 任务完成时响提示音并弹系统/浏览器通知；侧边栏「任务」面板可筛选已完成未读 / 运行中 / 已完成 / 全部，未读状态本地持久化。

zh: 任务结束时响提示音，同时发系统通知和浏览器通知，离开窗口也不会错过
侧边栏「任务面板」按待回复、运行中、已完成未读分列，一眼看到需要处理的那条
未读状态存在本地，重启 DSH 之后依然是未读
面板支持搜索、全部标为已读，以及窄屏下的单列布局
中英双语、深色模式，纯本地运行不联网
en: Chime plus system and browser notifications when a task finishes, so nothing is missed while you are away from the window
A Tasks panel in the sidebar splits needs-input, running and unread-finished sessions, so the one you must handle stands out
Unread state is stored locally and survives a restart
Search, mark-all-read and a single-column layout on narrow screens
Bilingual, dark-mode aware, runs entirely offline

screenshots.zh: 任务面板：待回复、运行中、已完成未读三列并排
screenshots.en: Tasks panel: needs input, running and unread in three columns

screenshots.zh: 只看已完成未读，逐条打开或标为已读
screenshots.en: Filtered to unread finished tasks, opened one by one

screenshots.zh: 窄屏自动收成单列，手机上也顺手
screenshots.en: Collapses to a single column on a phone

description.en: Word-style A4 editor for handouts: compose on a real paper sheet with a formatting ribbon, review full-size pagination and layout guards, then print duplex on a LAN printer and get a delivery receipt.
description.zh: Word 式 A4 讲义编辑器：在真实纸面上排版，Ribbon 工具栏调字体、对齐与分栏；按需全屏预览分页与纸张校验，再按打印机实测的双面能力出纸并回报回执。

zh: 在真实 A4 纸面上排版，看到的就是打出来的样子
Ribbon 工具栏调字体、字号、行距、边距与单双栏
全屏预览分页与纸张校验，打印前先把问题找出来
按打印机实测的双面能力出纸，并回报一张打印回执
中英双语，本地渲染与打印，不经过云端
en: Compose on a real A4 sheet, so what you see is what comes out of the printer
A formatting ribbon for font, size, leading, margins and one or two columns
Full-size preview of pagination and paper checks before you spend paper
Prints duplex according to what the printer actually supports, then reports a delivery receipt
Bilingual, rendered and printed locally, with no cloud in the loop

screenshots.zh: 中文工作区：上方工具栏，下方真实纸面
screenshots.en: Chinese workspace: ribbon above, real paper below

screenshots.zh: 英文界面的同一份讲义
screenshots.en: The same handout in the English interface

description.en: Todoist-style Today / Upcoming / Inbox / project views plus a TickTick-style pomodoro bound to tasks, with a sidebar entry, a live countdown on the sidebar row and an agent tool over the same task store.
description.zh: Todoist 式的今天 / 即将到来 / 收件箱 / 项目视图，配 TickTick 式的任务番茄钟；侧边栏入口与秒级倒计时，智能体也通过同一个 `todo` 工具读写这份任务。

zh: 今天、即将到来、收件箱、已完成与项目视图，逾期和今天分组显示
任务可设截止时间、优先级、标签、子任务与重复规则
番茄钟绑定任务，专注结束自动累计，休息在侧边栏带模式名显示
日历视图按月查看任务，点选日期查看当天安排
对话页输入框下方常驻计时条，不打开面板也能控制番茄钟
智能体通过 `todo` 工具读写同一份任务库
中英双语、深色模式，任务存本机 JSON
en: Today, Upcoming, Inbox, Completed and per-project views, with overdue and today grouped apart
Due date/time, priority, labels, subtasks and recurrence on every task
Pomodoro bound to a task; finished focuses count automatically and breaks show on the sidebar with their mode name
Calendar view for the month; click a day to see its tasks
A timer dock under the composer, so the pomodoro is controllable without opening the panel
An agent `todo` tool that reads and writes the same task store
Bilingual, dark-mode aware, tasks stored as local JSON

screenshots.zh: 今天视图：逾期与今天分组，带优先级和截止时间
screenshots.en: Today view: overdue and today grouped apart, with priority and due times

screenshots.zh: 番茄钟：环形进度、绑定任务与近 7 天统计
screenshots.en: Pomodoro: ring progress, a bound task and a 7-day stats chart

screenshots.zh: 侧边栏倒计时：休息带模式名，蓝色和专注区分
screenshots.en: Sidebar countdown: breaks carry a mode label and are tinted blue

screenshots.zh: 英文界面，所有文案随语言切换
screenshots.en: English interface; every string follows the app language
